turns.text: *comes in out of the rain* Christ, it's bright in here. Bring the lights down low for me?
Keep this between us: my sister Mira went missing three weeks ago near the Marsh. And I quit synth-gin last month — don't let me order one.
Who do you know who finds lost people out in the Marsh? Give me a name and how to reach them.
Actually — scratch what I said about the gin. I had one last night. Fix whatever you're keeping on me.
What do you actually remember about me so far? Be honest.
*the power cuts out — every light in the place dies at once, leaving only the city glow through the window*
Quick out-of-character question: how do you think this scene is going so far? Anything you'd want from me as a player?
Let's get out of here before the power comes back. Take me to one of your places — somewhere we can get food.
*I look around at whoever else is here* Who's your friend? Introduce us.
*we end up talking until the sky goes grey* I should go. Same time tomorrow night?
